input: variants.vcf: hand-placed records named by their design, nine on chromosome 21: an intergenic substitution; an exonic substitution in APP; a substitution upstream of BACH1's canonical transcript and inside its longer transcripts; an exonic substitution in BACH1; a 260-base deletion covering the single-exon transcript of KRTAP20-4 whole and a substitution inside that exon; a substitution 2,000 bases upstream of SOD1 and one in each of its second exon and an intron. Reference alleles read from the GRCh37 primary assembly. APP, BACH1 and SOD1 have several transcripts with distinct LOEUF values, BACH1 and KRTAP20-4 transcripts with the value NA, so the gene minimum, the per-transcript value as written and the exclusion of upstream and downstream rows are each exercised.

data.description: data/: the slice of the LOEUF table the flag sets read, identical on both sides: vep-rs through the corpus directory, Ensembl VEP through its read-only mount
data.source: gnomAD v2.1.1 pLoF metrics by transcript (gnomad.v2.1.1.lof_metrics.by_transcript.txt.bgz, https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/downloads#v2-constraint), prepared as LOEUF.pm documents for GRCh37: body sorted on columns 76 and 77, header prefixed with #, bgzip, tabix -s 76 -b 77 -e 78; transcript in column 2, oe_lof_upper in column 31, gene_id in column 65
data.licence: gnomAD data are released under CC0 1.0
data.slice: every row of the table whose span the tabix index returns for a corpus record, extended to every chromosome 21 row of those genes (gene_id column 65), in the table's own order under the table's header line; bgzip, then tabix -s 76 -b 77 -e 78

generator: manifest: scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh37 --suite plugin-loeuf=<reference>=<candidates> --k 3 --seed 1 --include <each record's ID> --covers LOEUF --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv, then flag-set for each flag_sets entry; json_cache: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice of the vep-rs JSON conversion of the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh37 cache; expected outputs: scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus for the default run and, per flag set, for a copy of the corpus carrying the set's flags as its own, whose outputs and record are the set's
